name: certgraph
summary: Crawl the graph of certificate Alternate Names.
highlights: -ct-expired — include expired certificates in certificate transparency search
-ct-subdomains — include sub-domains in certificate transparency search
-details — print details about the domains crawled
-dns — check for DNS records to determine if domain is registered
-driver — driver to use [crtsh, google, http, smtp] (default "http")
-json — print the graph as json, can be used for graph in web UI

flags.name: -ct-expired
flags.description: include expired certificates in certificate transparency search

flags.name: -ct-subdomains
flags.description: include sub-domains in certificate transparency search

flags.name: -details
flags.description: print details about the domains crawled

flags.name: -dns
flags.description: check for DNS records to determine if domain is registered

flags.name: -driver
flags.description: driver to use [crtsh, google, http, smtp] (default "http")

flags.name: -json
flags.description: print the graph as json, can be used for graph in web UI

flags.name: -parallel
flags.description: number of certificates to retrieve in parallel (default 10)

flags.name: -sanscap
flags.description: maximum number of uniq TLD+1 domains in certificate to include, 0 has no limit (default 80)

flags.name: -save
flags.description: save certs to folder in PEM format

flags.name: -tldplus1
flags.description: for every domain found, add tldPlus1 of the domain's parent

flags.name: -updatepsl
flags.description: Update the default Public Suffix List
